name: Product Slide Up

behavior.description: Move the product straight up from below with a quick fade, decelerating into its authored pose without bounce.
behavior.targetSelection: Animate all product hooks in the selected component together.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; easing at a keyframe applies to the following interval.

adaptation: x/y use design pixels in a 1080x1920 frame and scale with it; positive y is down. Rotation offsets are additive degrees and scale is a multiplier of the authored base scale. Opacity is absolute. Preserve authored rotations, clipping, layout, and other visual layers by composing motion separately. No requirement to start fully offscreen: the initial fade conceals the lower approach. Initialize at the assigned start, sample deterministically, and retain the final still pose.
